senses.meaning_vi: nhận, đón nhận (quà tặng, lời mời, vị trí)
senses.definition_en: to willingly take something that is offered or given
examples: She happily accepted the job offer from the multinational company.
Please accept this gift as a token of our gratitude.

synonyms.note_vi: nhận (trung tính, không nhất thiết thể hiện sự nhiệt tình)
cầm lấy, nhận lấy

senses.meaning_vi: đồng ý, chấp thuận (thỏa thuận, đề xuất)
senses.definition_en: to agree to an offer, proposal, or set of terms
examples: He asked her to marry him, and she accepted.
Both parties have accepted the terms of the agreement.

synonyms.note_vi: đồng ý với
ưng thuận, chuẩn thuận (trang trọng)
phê duyệt, tán thành

senses.meaning_vi: thừa nhận, công nhận (sự thật, trách nhiệm)
senses.definition_en: to believe that something is true, valid, or correct; to acknowledge responsibility
examples: He accepted full responsibility for the failure of the project.
Most scientists accept the validity of this theory.

synonyms.note_vi: ghi nhận, công nhận sự việc
thừa nhận (lỗi lầm, điều khó nói)
công nhận tính xác đáng

senses.meaning_vi: cam chịu, chấp nhận hoàn cảnh không thể thay đổi
senses.definition_en: to tolerate or resign oneself to an unpleasant or unavoidable situation
examples: You have to accept the reality that things won't always go your way.
It took her a long time to accept the loss of her business.

synonyms.note_vi: cam phận, phó mặc
học cách quen dần và chấp nhận nỗi đau/thực tế
chịu đựng, nhẫn nhịn

senses.meaning_vi: Tính kiên trì, sự bền chí, lòng nhẫn nại vượt khó
senses.definition_en: Continued effort and determination to achieve something despite difficulties, failure, or opposition
examples: Through hard work and perseverance, she successfully earned her medical degree.
His perseverance in the face of great adversity inspired everyone on the team.

synonyms.note_vi: Sự kiên trì, bền bỉ làm liên tục không ngắt quãng
Sự ngoan cường, kiên định bám đuổi mục tiêu đến cùng
Bản lĩnh, ý chí kiên cường trước khó khăn lâu dài
Ý chí quyết tâm đạt được điều gì đó

senses.meaning_vi: Sự kiên trì, bền bỉ, nhẫn nại
senses.definition_en: The quality of continuing to try to achieve a particular aim despite difficulties, failure, or opposition.
examples: Perseverance is essential for success in any long-term project.
She showed great perseverance in overcoming her physical disabilities.

synonyms.note_vi: Sự kiên trì làm gì đó cho đến cùng
Sự quyết tâm, không chịu buông bỏ
Sự quyết tâm cao độ

senses.definition_en: to take something that is offered or given to you
examples: She accepted his invitation to the dinner.
The company refused to accept responsibility for the error.

synonyms.note_vi: nhận lấy một cách trực tiếp
tiếp nhận thứ gì đó được gửi đến

senses.definition_en: to say yes to an offer or invitation; to believe that something is true
examples: I am happy to accept your proposal.
It took him a long time to accept the fact that he had lost.

synonyms.note_vi: đồng ý với đề nghị
bằng lòng về mặt pháp lý hoặc chính thức

senses.definition_en: to tolerate or endure something unpleasant
examples: You have to accept the reality of the situation.

đành cam chịu

reading_passages.title: Living in a Digital World
reading_passages.passage: In our modern society, technology has changed the way we live every single day. We rely on smartphones and laptops to stay connected with friends, work remotely, and manage our personal schedules. It is fascinating how much information we can access with just a few clicks. For many businesses, maintaining a reliable database is crucial. This system allows companies to store and organize huge amounts of customer information safely. Although some people worry that technology makes us less social, it also provides us with amazing tools to learn new skills and explore the world from our homes. As we continue to integrate these digital tools into our daily routines, it is important to find a healthy balance between our online activities and our real-life experiences.
reading_passages.topic: Daily life, technology and modern society

questions.question: What is the main purpose of a database for businesses according to the text?
options: To store and organize customer information
To connect with friends on social media
questions.explanation: Đoạn văn nêu rõ hệ thống này giúp các công ty lưu trữ và sắp xếp thông tin khách hàng.

questions.question: How does the author feel about the role of technology in society?
options: It is unnecessary for modern life
It has both benefits and potential drawbacks
questions.explanation: Tác giả thừa nhận công nghệ có những mặt lợi ích nhưng cũng lưu ý về sự cân bằng và nỗi lo lắng của con người.

questions.question: What does the word 'it' refer to in the sentence 'It is fascinating how much information we can access'?
options: The fact that we can access information easily
questions.explanation: Trong ngữ cảnh này, 'it' là chủ ngữ giả dùng để chỉ việc chúng ta có thể truy cập thông tin dễ dàng là điều thú vị.

reading_passages.title: Learning in the Digital Age
reading_passages.passage: In the modern world, technology has completely changed how we acquire knowledge. Today, students can access online courses from anywhere, which offers great flexibility. However, learning through digital platforms is not always easy. It requires a great deal of perseverance to keep studying when you encounter difficult problems alone in front of a screen. Sometimes, technical issues or complex subjects can be frustrating, so students must be resilient to overcome these setbacks instead of giving up. Successful learners are those who dedicate enough time to practice and explore new tools effectively. Whether you are using a language app or attending a virtual lecture, the key to success lies in your attitude toward challenges. By combining the right technology with a determined mindset, anyone can achieve their educational goals and continue to grow in this fast-paced digital environment.

questions.question: According to the passage, why is online learning sometimes challenging?
options: Because students often have to study alone and face difficult problems
Because virtual teachers are not very helpful
Because there are no courses available for students
questions.explanation: Đoạn văn đề cập rằng việc học qua màn hình có thể khó khăn khi học sinh phải đối mặt với các vấn đề phức tạp một mình.

questions.question: What does the author suggest students should be to overcome setbacks?
questions.explanation: Tác giả nêu rõ học sinh cần phải 'resilient' (kiên cường) để vượt qua những trở ngại thay vì bỏ cuộc.

questions.question: What is needed to succeed in digital learning according to the text?
options: A lot of money to buy new devices
Dedicating time to practice and having a positive attitude
questions.explanation: Bài đọc nhấn mạnh việc dành thời gian (dedicate time) luyện tập và có thái độ đúng đắn là chìa khóa để thành công.

reading_passages.title: Technology in the Modern Library
reading_passages.passage:
Modern technology changes our daily life in many ways. Today, many people visit local libraries not just to read printed books, but to use modern computers. At the community library in my town, there is a large digital database that stores thousands of electronic books, articles, and audio files. When a student needs information for a school project, it is very easy to find the right material online.

The library system works quickly because the database organizes information by title, author, and subject. Anyone with a library card can log in from home. For example, my younger sister loves reading fairy tales, and she often searches for them on her tablet. When she finds a new story, it takes only a few seconds to download.

Technology has truly made learning faster and more convenient for society. In the past, people spent hours searching through paper shelves, but now they can discover knowledge with just one click. It connects people to global information and improves our daily routines.
reading_passages.topic: Daily life, technology and modern society

questions.question: What does the library's digital database store?
options: Electronic books, articles, and audio files
questions.explanation: Đoạn 1 nêu rõ: 'there is a large digital database that stores thousands of electronic books, articles, and audio files' (có một cơ sở dữ liệu kỹ thuật số lớn lưu trữ hàng ngàn sách điện tử, bài báo và tệp âm thanh).

questions.question: How can people access the library system from home?
options: By logging in with a library card
By writing a letter to the library
questions.explanation: Đoạn 2 nêu rõ: 'Anyone with a library card can log in from home' (Bất kỳ ai có thẻ thư viện đều có thể đăng nhập từ nhà).

questions.question: In the sentence 'When she finds a new story, it takes only a few seconds to download', what does 'it' refer to?
options: The act of downloading the story
questions.explanation: 'It' trong cấu trúc 'it takes... to download' dùng để chỉ hành động/việc tải câu chuyện mới về chỉ mất vài giây.
